result.title: The Price of Hard Coverage Constraints in Online Conformal Prediction
result.summary: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free uncertainty quantification, but in sequential deployment, standard coverage guarantees can still allow substantial fluctuations in the number of miscoverages over time. We study an online setting in which prediction sets are produced one round at a time and the cumulative number of miscoverages must stay within a prescribed budget throughout deployment.Such a hard coverage guarantee can be enforced by enlarging prediction sets, but how much additional prediction-set size is fundamentally necessary remains unclear. We characterize this unavoidable efficiency cost over $T$ prediction rounds. Remarkably, the cost persists even with i.i.d.\ data, a known score distribution, and perfect knowledge of the population-optimal prediction set. Under suitable regularity conditions relating coverage and prediction-set size, we determine the minimum cumulative excess prediction-set size required by any online method satisfying the hard coverage constraint. This minimum cost is $Θ(\log T)$ for expected cost at a fixed time known in advance, $Θ(T^{1/3})$ for the largest expected cost over all fixed times up to $T$, and $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ for the expected worst realized cost when the evaluation time is chosen in hindsight. We further show that these rates can be attained using past scores, without knowing the score distribution. Thus, even perfect statistical knowledge does not make sequential reliability free.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究在线保形预测中「硬覆盖约束」的效率代价：在每轮生成预测集且累积误覆盖数须始终控制在给定预算内的设定下，刻画任意方法为满足该约束所必然付出的额外预测集大小，并给出 Θ(log T)、Θ(T^{1/3})、Θ(√T) 三种依评估时机的下界与可达性。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究主线关注 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本，而该文的「累积误覆盖预算」提供了序列式停止与风险控制的形式化视角，其效率代价下界或可供核查 STOP 决策在不牺牲可靠性前提下的最小成本；但纯属理论且无多模态实验，联系偏远。
